subject: Request: onboarding credits for RapidTrial trial (self-serve signup)
messages:
From: Alicia Martinez <alicia@rapidtrial.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-21T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: New account — request for onboarding credits

Hi team,

We just created a self-serve account this morning (RapidTrial) and have been experimenting in the Redwood playground. Our early integration tests are promising, but we’re already bumping against the trial limits. We’re a small dev team (3 engineers) building an intelligent test-case generation demo and need more tokens to finish a proof-of-concept for a partner call next week.

Quick details:
- Primary use: generation + safety checks, ~1.5k tokens per session, ~40 sessions/day during POC.
- Current blocker: cannot complete end-to-end flow due to token cap.
- Timeline: need extra quota by Tues 23 Jun to run final integration tests for partner demo.

What we’re asking: an onboarding credit bump (approx 50k–100k tokens) or a short trial extension so we can finish the POC. Happy to share more context or a short Loom of our flow.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Martinez
Head of Integrations, RapidTrial
alicia@rapidtrial.io
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: rapidtrial-integration-screenshot.png (PNG screenshot of playground session)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Alicia Martinez <alicia@rapidtrial.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New account — request for onboarding credits

Hi Alicia — welcome and thanks for the details, this is exactly the kind of info we need. I can triage this from the PLG intake side and expedite to approvals if needed. A few quick clarifying Qs:

1) Are you using the hosted Redwood API or the playground-only flows for the POC?
2) Do you expect to keep using the hosted API after the POC (rough yes/no)?
3) Any compliance red flags (sensitive PII, PHI) in your test data?

We typically grant an initial 50k token onboarding credit for self-serve signups that validate an integration. If the use-case and timing justify it, I can ask Marissa to approve up to 75k as a one-off for partner demos.

I’ve attached a short intake form for your integration notes (playground-intake-form.pdf) — please fill the fields marked with bold so I can move this to approvals today. If you want, we can also do a quick 15-min call this afternoon to walk through the flow and speed approval.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 415 222 7810

Attachment: playground-intake-form.pdf (fillable intake form)

- Grant amount: 75,000 tokens
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance
- Note to billing: no invoice/charge — promotional onboarding credit

Rishi — can you (or Billing) issue the credit in HubSpot/Console and post the credit-grant-stub.pdf to the thread once done? Tag me in the HubSpot deal (RAP-9843).

Marissa
